description: Generate a task-aware local context packet with primary files, related files, tests, and validation commands. Uses a per-user external cache and leaves the target repository unchanged. Deterministic by default; pass online:true to also ask a read model (TypeSafe's Jev with TYPESAFE_API_KEY, or Claude with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or SOLUMBE_READ_PROVIDER=claude) what kind of work the request is and which candidate files it needs, which relabels a confidently read intent and demotes files it judges irrelevant, reported under modelRead.

includeEvidence.description: Include per-file imports, exports, and symbol slices as source evidence. Defaults to false to keep the packet compact.

includeMarkdown.description: Return a compact human-readable markdown report instead of the full JSON packet. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum primary, related, and test files per section. Defaults to 8.

online.description: Ask a read model (TypeSafe's Jev, or Claude through forced tool use) to read the request (intent, and relevance of each candidate file) in one call, and apply answers that clear their confidence gate. Needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (SOLUMBE_READ_PROVIDER picks one when both are set); without either the pack is returned unchanged with modelRead.source offline. Defaults to false.

path.description: Repository path. Defaults to current working directory.

paths.description: Repository paths for a multi-repo context packet. Omitted, `path` plus the `companions` listed in its .solumberc.json.

query.description: Task or question to gather context for.

name: context_pack
title: Context Pack
